description_en: The Jayeśvara Mahādeva Mandira is located at Śaṅkhamūla (Shankhamul) in Patan and faces south. The temple was constructed by Raṇadhvaja Thāpā, the first son of Amara Siṃha Thāpā and his wife Dharmādevī. The exact year of the temple's construction is unknown. The stone pillar erected in the courtard features a statue of Raṇadhvaja Thāpā and bears inscriptions on four sides recording various events related to the temple. The earliest record among them is from VS 1877 (1820 CE), mentioning that the temple was constructed in that year. Many plots of land were donated to formguthis for performing daily rituals and other worships at the temple. In VS 1879 (1822 CE), Raṇadhvaja had his family tree (vaṃśavṛkṣa) inscribed on the pillar and installed his statue atop of it. According to the priest, the temple had a four-tiered roof before it's collapse in the 1934 CE earthquake. Members of theguthireconstructed the temple with only two roofs and in 2001 CE (VS 2058) it was reconstructed again, using concrete amd cement plaster.A Khanāla Brahmin serves as the priest of the remple. He carries out the daily worship in the mornings and offersāratīin the evenings, for which he receives 3,500 rupees per month from the Jayeśvara Mahādeva Guthi. On the day of Śivarātrī, theśivaliṅgain the sanctum receives a coat of oil and oil lamps are lit around the temple.
description_ne: शङ्खमूलमा निर्माण गरिएको यो मन्दिरको मूलद्वार दक्षिणाभिमुख रहेको छ । यो मन्दिर रणध्वज थापाले निर्माण गराएका थिए । नेपालको इतिहासमा वीर सेनापति भनी चिनिएका अमरसिंह थापाका धर्मादेवीपट्टिका जेठा छोरा रणध्वज थापा हुन् । यो मन्दिर कुन सालमा निर्माण गरिएको थियो भन्ने कुरा स्पष्ट छैन । मन्दिरको दक्षिणमा रहेको रणध्वज थापाको मूर्ति राखिएको शिलास्तम्भमा चारै दिशामा मन्दिरसँग सम्बन्धित विभिन्न घटनाक्रमहरू कुँदिएका छन् । ती घटनाक्रमहरू मध्ये सबभन्दा पुरानो विसं १८७७ (सन् १८२०) को रहेको छ । यसकै आधारमा यो मन्दिर विसं १८७७ (सन् १८२०) तिर नै निर्माण गरिएको अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ । मन्दिर स्थापना गरेपछि मन्दिर सञ्चालनको लागि थुप्रै जग्गाजमीन गुठी राखिएको थियो । विसं १८७९ (सन् १८२२) मा रणध्वज थापाले आफ्नो वंशावली लेखाई शिलास्तम्भमाथि आफ्नो प्रतिमा पनि स्थापना गरेका थिए । पूजारीका अनुसार पहिले यो मन्दिरमा चार तहको झिंगटीको  छाना राखिएको थियो । विसं १९९० सालको भूकम्पले मन्दिर भत्केपछि गुठीयारहरूले नै मन्दिरको पुनर्निर्माण गरेका थिए । पुनर्निर्माण गर्दा पहिलेको चार तहको छाना नराखी दुई तहको मात्र छाना राखिएको थियो । विसं २०५८ (सन् २००१) तिर ढलान गरेर मन्दिरको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो ।यस मन्दिरमा खनाल थरका ब्राह्मणलाई पूजारीको रूपमा नियुक्त गरिएको छ । उनले बिहान नित्यपूजा गरी बेलुकी आरती दिने गर्छन् । त्यसवापत जयेश्वर महादेवको गुठीले उनलाई महिनाको रु. ३५ सय पारिश्रमिक दिने गरेको छ । प्रत्येक वर्ष शिवरात्रिको दिनमा गर्भगृहभित्र रहेको शिवलिङ्गमा तेल घसिन्छ । त्यस दिन मन्दिर वरिपरि बत्ती बालिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Raṇadhvaja Thāpā, the founder of the temple donated plots of land and established asadāvartaguthifor the temple's maintenance.

historical_events.event_name: Installation of a statue of Raṇadhvaja Thāpā
historical_events.event_description: Raṇadhvaja Thāpā had his family tree inscribed on the pillar and installed his own statue atop of it.

historical_events.event_name: Endowment of land for Narmadeśvara  and Umāmaheśvara
historical_events.event_description: Land measuring 15ropanīswere endowed to maintain the Narmadeśvara and Umāmaheśvara temples, located around the Jayeśvara Mahādeva Mandira.
Several plots of land measuring 95ropanīswere endowed for the operation and maintenance of the Jayeśvara Mahādeva Mandira including other temples around it.

historical_events.event_name: Endowment of lands by King Rājendra
historical_events.event_description: King Rājendra donated plots of land measuring 76murīsof crop yields to Jayeśvara Mahādeva.
Raṇadhvaj, the founder of the temple, purchasedt several plots of land in different places to endow theguthifor the temple.
All above mentioned events were inscribed on the Raṇadhvaja Thāpā pillar in VS 1900.
